answers.question: Did the agent stay on the shift offer without inventing other topics as facts?
answers.quote: [agent] I just wanted to check if you'd like to take the wound care shift on Monday from 9:29pm to 5:29am in Jersey City for $40 an hour. Are you interested in this shift?

answers.question: Did the agent close politely when the nurse had to go?
answers.quote: [agent] Thanks for letting me know you need some time to think it over. I appreciate it, and have a great day!
